description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), causes [Imperil Earth 20% (25s)] and [Imperil Holy 20% (25s)], grants [Awoken Cosmic Warrior], [Damage Cap +10000], [High Quick Cast] and [Twin Element Mode (Earth, Holy)] to the user

description.name: Awoken Cosmic Warrior
description.text: Earth and Holy abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Earth and Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Earth, Holy)
description.text: Grants [Attach Earth]/[Attach Holy] after using a Earth/Holy ability
